purpose: Declarative review-depth interpretation; this file deploys no controller and grants no actions.

thresholds.use: Playground/shadow examples only. Production requires approved review-routing calibration for the pinned model and question version. Missing, nonnumeric, nonfinite or out-of-range scores are invalid; missing/invalid answers block interpretation. Middle-band values are uncertain, not passes.

preparation: Preserve original requirements and AC, current PR/head, actual change facts, applicable human decisions and source gaps in any readable format.
Fetch per-case CI results, retain retries/skips/errors, and tie artifacts to head/pipeline/job/attempt using provider metadata. An aggregate success is not per-AC proof.
Separate absent scope from work the independent reviewer can perform. Missing review results are expected before review; do not require 06B evidence to enter 06B.
factual_gates: Reconcile the completion candidate to the authorized session and current PR/head; Stop alone proves nothing.
Required CI pending: wait; failed: return to existing implementation session. Missing/skipped required checks need configured applicability; unknown is not passed.
Establish authoritative repository policy, reviewer access/capacity and exact action grants before live launch.
Verify provenance for test evidence relied on to justify 06A. Unbound reports can inform shadow exploration but cannot prove current-head acceptance.
Reuse qualifying current-head reviews; deduplicate requests by head, scope and policy.

route_rules.action: Identify missing scope/intent and gather authorized evidence, then refetch and repeat 05. Ask a human only for a concrete human-owned decision or access/setup obstacle.

route_rules.when: The ticket already completed a 06B independent review on an earlier head, then went to QA, QA returned it (validated QA return), and it is back at 05 after the QA rework
route_rules.action: Operator cost rule: route 06A, not 06B. Overrides repository require_independent_review, the validated-QA-reopen trigger, positive/uncertain verification predicates and the GitHub-coverage condition. Still requires sufficient context and passing/attributable CI; still report all human-attention items. Does not apply to 06B CHANGES_REQUESTED loops before the ticket reached QA, or to a ticket whose QA return predates its first 06B.

route_rules.when: Repository requires independent review, a validated QA reopen exists, or applicable domain policy requires deeper review
behavior_verification_needed or cross_component_verification_needed is positive or uncertain
static_review_sufficient is positive, both verification-needed predicates are negative, and repository accepts configured GitHub review coverage
Context is sufficient but the 06A conditions are not established

business_logic_changed: Context for configured domain policy, not a universal 06B trigger. Resolve applicable authorization/pricing/data policy before launch; unknown policy cannot justify 06A.

human_attention.human_verification_required: Exact human-only acceptance check, build and responsible role.
human_attention.positive: Locate the concrete unresolved decision/check and reuse existing scoped resolutions; no generic approval request.
human_attention.uncertain: Investigate the evidence and existing decisions first. Do not automatically escalate or treat uncertainty as a negative. If unresolved, hold dependent progress.
human_attention.negative: No semantic escalation supported by this answer; explicit required approvals remain factual gates.

combination: Apply route rules in order after valid answers. Retain all independent reasons and human items even when context or a factual gate blocks launch. A route recommendation never proves correctness or authorizes execution. Authorized review evidence collection may continue while an unrelated human decision is pending; dependent progress waits. Never downgrade review depth for missing access or quota.
